fixtures.summary: India chased 296 with more than eight overs to spare, led by hundreds from Kohli and Gill. West Indies' openers can score, but Kuldeep took the game away from them.

factors.name: Recent form
factors.note: India won the 1st ODI by 8 wickets, chasing 296 in 41.4 overs.

factors.name: Head-to-head
factors.note: West Indies have not won a series in India for 24 years.

factors.name: Home advantage
factors.note: Home crowd and Indian pitches that suit India's spinners.

factors.name: Venue record
factors.note: India's home venue, though Guwahati has hosted relatively few ODIs.

factors.name: Pitch, weather & toss
factors.note: Late-season rain is possible in Guwahati; forecast to be checked on match day.

factors.name: Batting strength
factors.note: India's top three scored 281 of their 300 runs. West Indies' 295 relied on the openers and Jangoo.

factors.name: Bowling attack
factors.note: Kuldeep took 4-40. West Indies' best figures were Chase's 1-64 as India cruised.

factors.name: Spin matchup
factors.note: Kuldeep removed both West Indies openers to stop a 135-run start.

factors.name: Key player form
factors.note: Kohli 139* and Gill 110. Greaves made 101 for West Indies.

factors.name: Captain & coach record
factors.note: Gambhir coached India to the 2025 Champions Trophy. Hope and Sammy are rebuilding after West Indies missed the 2023 World Cup.

factors.name: Injuries & availability
factors.note: No injury news for either side. Sammy plans to give all 15 squad members games, which may weaken West Indies' XI.

factors.name: Motivation & rotation
factors.note: West Indies must win to keep the series alive and want a benchmark before February's World Cup Qualifiers.

fixtures.series: West Indies tour of India 2026–27: ODIs

fixtures.summary: South Africa's spinners have beaten Australia's batting twice and Miller and Bavuma are in form. The series is already won, so SA may rest players, which keeps Australia in it.

factors.name: Recent form
factors.note: SA won the 1st ODI by 67 runs and the 2nd by 32. Australia had lost four of five ODI series before sweeping Zimbabwe 3–0.

factors.name: Head-to-head
factors.note: South Africa have won six bilateral ODI series in a row against Australia.

factors.name: Home advantage
factors.note: Early-season South African pitches and a home crowd.

factors.name: Venue record
factors.note: Potchefstroom hosts few ODIs, so there is little venue history for either side.

factors.name: Pitch, weather & toss
factors.note: Day/night game. Dew later in the evening could help the side batting second; forecast to be checked on match day.

factors.name: Batting strength
factors.note: SA made 297 and 365 batting first. Australia were bowled out for 230 and 333.

factors.name: Bowling attack
factors.note: SA's spinners have done the damage, but their pace attack is thin. Edwards (5-67) and Hazlewood (3-70) bowled well for Australia.

factors.name: Spin matchup
factors.note: Australia have the worst record of any side against left-arm spin since the last World Cup. Markram, Maharaj and Fortuin took 5 for 179 in the 2nd ODI.

factors.name: Key player form
factors.note: Miller (142) and Bavuma (103) scored hundreds on Sunday and Breetzke made one in Durban. Head and Marsh both made 84.

factors.name: Captain & coach record
factors.note: Bavuma and Conrad lead a side on a long winning run against Australia. Marsh has captained Australia in 13 of their 31 ODIs since the 2023 World Cup.

factors.name: Injuries & availability
factors.note: SA are without Rabada, Ngidi, Baartman, Maphaka and Burger. Green is managing a sore shoulder for Australia.

factors.name: Motivation & rotation
factors.note: Series decided. SA may rest players before the Tests; Australia are playing for pride.

fixtures.series: Australia tour of South Africa 2026–27: ODIs

players.stats: 142 off 93 balls, 12 fours and 9 sixes (2nd ODI)
players.achievement: Career-best ODI score and his 8th ODI hundred; beat his previous best of 139, also against Australia.
players.concern: Now in the later stage of his career, so workload may be managed.
players.name: David Miller

players.achievement: His sixth ODI hundred, and his first in ODIs at his home ground.
players.concern: It was his first ODI hundred in three years.
players.name: Temba Bavuma

players.achievement: Player of the series when SA won 2–1 in Australia in 2025.
players.concern: With the pace attack depleted, SA rely heavily on him.
players.name: Keshav Maharaj

players.stats: ODI average 59.16 across 13 innings, strike rate near 100
players.achievement: Hundred in the 1st ODI in Durban.
players.concern: Still early in his ODI career.
players.name: Matthew Breetzke

players.achievement: One of the world's most dangerous openers; a big innings can decide a match.
players.concern: Australia's top order has struggled against South Africa's spinners.
players.name: Travis Head

players.achievement: Led the 3–0 sweep of Zimbabwe before this series.
players.concern: Has lost this series 2–0 as captain.
players.name: Mitchell Marsh

players.achievement: First ODI five-wicket haul, restricting SA after they were 93 for 3.
players.concern: Went for 67 runs as Miller attacked.
players.name: Jack Edwards

players.stats: 122 ODI runs in 8 innings, two fifties
players.achievement: Two ODI half-centuries.
players.concern: Low total output with the bat so far.
players.name: Xavier Bartlett

leaders.record: Has now won two ODI series against Australia as captain, including 2–1 in Australia in 2025.
leaders.achievement: Led South Africa to the 2023–25 World Test Championship title, beating Australia in the final.
leaders.concern: Carries both captaincy and top-order batting duties in a side short of senior bowlers.
leaders.name: Temba Bavuma

leaders.record: Test coach since January 2023; took on the white-ball teams as well in 2025.
leaders.achievement: Coached SA to the 2023–25 World Test Championship title.
leaders.concern: Has to manage a fast-bowling injury crisis ahead of eight Tests this summer.
leaders.name: Shukri Conrad

leaders.record: Captained 13 of Australia's 31 ODIs since the 2023 World Cup.
leaders.achievement: Cummins led Australia to the 2023 World Cup title.
leaders.concern: Australia lost four of five ODI series before the recent Zimbabwe sweep.
leaders.name: Mitchell Marsh (sharing with Pat Cummins)

leaders.record: Head coach through Australia's 2023 World Cup win.
leaders.achievement: 2023 ODI World Cup winners under his coaching.
leaders.concern: Australia lost the 2025 World Test Championship final to South Africa.
leaders.name: Andrew McDonald
